name: DataView
description: A bound view over an approved host read model without embedding its records in source.

source.description: Approved host read-model address, not a URL, query, or executable data source.

filter.description: Declarative host-allowlisted field keys to JSON scalar or scalar-list values. Nested objects and executable predicates are unsupported; these values are never SQL.

sort.description: Ordered host-validated sort keys, optionally prefixed with a minus for descending order.

group.description: Optional host field key used for grouping.

limit.description: Requested result limit. Hosts enforce their own stricter bound.

validation: source, columns, filters, sort, grouping, and projection must be allowlisted by the host
source must not contain SQL, a network URL, credentials, or authorization claims
records remain outside RelayMark and outside collaborative text storage
